intent: Escalates a BedrockCommand from this node to another node in the cluster (leader, a named peer, or all peers) over a pooled TCP socket and fills in the command's response.

objects.name: SQLiteClusterMessenger
objects.role: opens/reuses a socket to a peer, sends a serialized command, and reads back its response

objects.name: SQLiteClusterMessenger::WaitForReadyResult
objects.role: outcome of waiting for a socket to become ready (timeout, disconnect, abort, etc.)

name_fit.note: clearly a messenger between nodes, sits correctly with SQLiteNode/SQLitePeer.

naming_quality.note: two overloaded runOnPeer methods (bool vs. peer-name) have different retry semantics but the same name.
